title: Legacy of Yu
subtitle: Solo-Only Non-Destructive Narrative Legacy Campaign
tagline: Tame the surging floods of the Yellow River and defend against barbarian raids in a self-balancing solo campaign.
loreSummary: Set in ancient China during the reign of Emperor Shun, you are Yu the Great, tasked by the imperial court with channeling the catastrophic floodwaters of the Yellow River while defending your canals against invading barbarian hordes. Build canals, train townsfolk, and read parables from a dynamic, resetting story deck.
keyFeatures: Dedicated solo-only worker placement and deck-building design by Shem Phillips (Garphill Games)
Non-destructive legacy campaign: fully resettable without stickers or destroyed components
Self-balancing story deck that introduces new cards and adapts difficulty whether you win or lose
Race to achieve 7 victories before suffering 7 defeats across an interconnected historical saga

legacy_of_yu_flood_campaign.name: The Taming of the Yellow River (7–10 Games)
legacy_of_yu_flood_campaign.description: The complete solo campaign arc playing through consecutive games until achieving 7 victories or suffering 7 catastrophic defeats.

legacy_of_yu_first_canals.name: First Canals & Defense (First 3 Games)
legacy_of_yu_first_canals.description: An introductory 3-game journey mastering canal dredging, worker drafting, and early barbarian repelling.

legacy_of_yu_master_engineer.name: Legendary Yu the Great (All Parables & Max Difficulty)
legacy_of_yu_master_engineer.description: An exhaustive solo mastery test seeking to trigger every narrative parable and conquer hardened barbarian cards.
